name: Molmo2-8B-Minimax-H3 (community INT8 ConvRot package, MolmoPoint trackers)

lineage.how_derived: INT8 ConvRot (block-Hadamard rotations plus per-channel INT8 weights, dynamic INT8 activations) and NVFP4 AWQ quantizations; a separate projector maps Molmo2 features to the MiniMax H3 video model's CLIP space

purpose: Experimental text and visual conditioning for the MiniMax H3 video model through ComfyUI nodes, plus MolmoPoint-8B point tracking for video segmentation (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE and NOTICE read at the head (Apache License 2.0); upstream Molmo2 licences were not opened.

architecture.kind: Molmo2 8B vision-language with custom INT8 ConvRot loaders

variants.notes: MolmoPoint INT8 10.42 GB, MolmoPoint NVFP4 AWQ 7.38 GB, H3 projector 0.34 GB; custom loaders only

pc-12gb.notes: 9.65 GB against a VRAM budget of 9.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-16gb.notes: 9.65 GB against a VRAM budget of 13.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-24gb.notes: 9.65 GB against a VRAM budget of 21.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-32gb.notes: 9.65 GB against a VRAM budget of 29.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

mac-16-24gb.notes: 9.65 GB against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 9.65 GB against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 9.65 GB against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

other: custom convrot_runtime.py loader on CUDA PyTorch

weaknesses: the Molmo2 to H3 projection is experimental and inconsistent for reference-to-video (card)
no accuracy benchmark for the quantized packages, only a smoke test on an eight-frame clip

tona_fit.reason: ComfyUI video-conditioning packaging of existing Molmo2/MolmoPoint weights with custom quantization loaders; outside Tona's scope.

open_questions: upstream Molmo2 licence text and benchmarks (not part of this repack)
